v7.name: v7
v7.description: Increases MaxBalLookback to 320 in preparation for the twin seeds change.

v8.name: v8
v8.description: Uses the new parameters and seed derivation policy from the agreement protocol's security analysis.

v11.name: v11
v11.description: Introduces efficient encoding of SignedTxn using SignedTxnInBlock.

v12.name: v12
v12.description: Increases the maximum length of a version string.

https://github.com/algorand/spec/tree/0c.name: v13
https://github.com/algorand/spec/tree/0c.description: Makes the consensus version a meaningful string.

https://github.com/algorand/spec/tree/25.name: v14
https://github.com/algorand/spec/tree/25.description: Adds tracking of closing amounts in ApplyData, and enables genesis hash in transactions.

https://github.com/algorand/spec/tree/a2.name: v15
https://github.com/algorand/spec/tree/a2.description: Adds tracking of reward distributions in ApplyData.

https://github.com/algorand/spec/tree/22.name: v16
https://github.com/algorand/spec/tree/22.description: Fixes domain separation in Credentials and requires GenesisHash.

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v17
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Points to 'final' spec commit for 2019 june release

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v18
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Points to reward calculation spec commit

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v19
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Points to 'final' spec commit for 2019 nov release

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v20
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Points to adding the decimals field to assets

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v21
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Fixes a bug in credential.lowestOutput

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v22
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Allows tuning the upgrade delay.

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v23
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Fixes lease behavior.

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v24
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Include the applications, rekeying and AVM v2

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v25
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Adds support for AssetCloseAmount in the ApplyData

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v26
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Adds support for TEAL 3, initial rewards calculation and merkle tree hash commitments

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v27
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Updates ApplyDelta.EvalDelta.LocalDeltas format

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v28
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Introduces new TEAL features, larger program size, fee pooling and longer asset max URL

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v29
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Fixes application update by using ExtraProgramPages in size calculations

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v30
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Introduces AVM 1.0 and TEAL 5, increases the app opt in limit to 50, and allows costs to be pooled in grouped stateful transactions.

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v31
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Enables the batch verification for ed25519 signatures, Fix reward calculation issue, introduces the ability to force an expired participation offline, enables TEAL 6 ( AVM 1.1 ) and add support for creating state proof keys.

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v32
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Enables the unlimited assets.

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v33
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Enables large blocks, the deeper block history for TEAL and catchpoint generation round after lowering in-memory deltas size (320 -> 4).

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v34
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Enables the TEAL v7 opcodes, stateproofs, shorter lambda to 1.7s.

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v35
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Updates the calculation of total stake in state proofs.

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v36
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Adds box storage in TEAL v8

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v37
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Is a technical upgrade and released in the same time as ConsensusV38. It is needed to allow nodes to build up a necessary state to support state proofs related options in ConsensusV38

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v38
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Enables state proof verification using a special tracker, TEAL v9 resources sharing, pre-check ECDSA curve and extra features, and shortens the lambda to 1.5s.

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v39
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Enables dynamic filter timeouts, a deadline timeout of 4 seconds, TEAL v10 logicSig opcode budget pooling along with elliptic curve ops on some pairing friendly curves.

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v40
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Enables consensus incentives and TEAL v11 featuring the mimc opcode

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v41
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Enables txn access, Sha512BlockHash, AppVersioning and TEAL v12 including the falcon verify opcode

https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.name: v42
https://github.com/algorandfoundation/sp.description: Enables app size updates, Falcon1024 post-quantum signatures, load tracking, a per-byte transaction surcharge, and TEAL v13.

future.name: vFuture
future.description: Is a protocol that should not appear in any production network, but is used to test features before they are released.

alpha1.name: alpha1
alpha1.description: Is the first consensus protocol for AlphaNet, which is the same as v32, but with a 2-second filter timeout and 5M block size.

alpha2.name: alpha2
alpha2.description: Is the second consensus protocol for AlphaNet, which increases the filter timeout to 3.5 seconds and uses 5MiB blocks.

alpha3.name: alpha3
alpha3.description: Uses the same parameters as ConsensusV33.

alpha4.name: alpha4
alpha4.description: Uses the same parameters as ConsensusV34.

alpha5.name: alpha5
alpha5.description: Uses the same parameters as ConsensusV36.

fnet1.name: fnet1
fnet1.description: Is the genesis protocol for AF's FNet, based on ConsensusV39 with incentives (payouts/challenges) and TEAL v11 enabled.

fnet2.name: fnet2
fnet2.description: Guards against a block-opcode change the fnet1 client did not support; same parameters as fnet1.

fnet3.name: fnet3
fnet3.description: Disables challenges; without heartbeats, participating accounts were being evicted.

fnet4.name: fnet4
fnet4.description: Re-enables challenges and brings heartbeats; upgrades to ConsensusV40.
